The '''Mandalorian Hunter''' armor a model of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]]. It was the primary armor set used by most [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] soldiers, mercenaries, and bounty hunters throughout during the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Galactic War]], [[war against Zakuul]], and the [[third Galactic War]]. Though most commonly seen in color blue, other Mandalorians choose to use other colors for their armor.
